layers.name: Surface duct
layers.note: Loud and exposed: everyone above and below hears you.

layers.name: Gradient layer
layers.note: The boundary itself: crossing it hides you and blinds you.

layers.name: Deep channel
layers.note: Quiet and hard to reach; your own sensors reach less far.

layers.name: Shadow zone
layers.note: The deepest band: nearly invisible from above, nearly blind yourself.
